title: Unit 5: Population - Key Vocabulary & Terminology
content:
📌 Population Density (Noun Phrase)
• English: The measurement of the number of people or individuals living per unit of area.
• Amharic: የሕዝብ ጥግግት (በአንድ የቦታ ስፋት የሚኖር የሕዝብ ብዛት)
• Synonyms: Population concentration, Demographics
• Antonyms: Sparseness, Low density
• Example: Urban areas like Lagos have a very high population density.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Sparsely Populated (Adjective Phrase)
• English: Containing a small or thinly scattered number of people relative to the land area.
• Amharic: በስሱ የተየዘ / ዝቅተኛ የሕዝብ ቁጥር ያለው
• Synonyms: Thinly populated, Uncrowded
• Antonyms: Densely populated, Crowded, Overpopulated
• Example: Rural and mountainous areas are often sparsely populated.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Inhospitable (Adjective)
• English: (Of an environment or position) harsh and difficult to live in or inhabit.
• Amharic: ለኑሮ የማይመች / አጋዥ ያልሆነ
• Synonyms: Hostile, Uninhabitable, Unwelcoming
• Antonyms: Hospitable, Habitable, Welcoming
• Example: Extreme desert regions are inhospitable environments for human habitation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Demographic Transition (Noun Phrase)
• English: A historical shift or process of change from high birth and death rates to low birth and death rates as a country develops.
• Amharic: የሕዝብ ቁጥር እድገት ሂደት ሽግግር
• Synonyms: Population transition, Demographic shift
• Antonyms: Demographic stagnation
• Example: Stage 2 of the demographic transition shows a falling death rate and high birthrate.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Collocation (Noun)
• English: A familiar grouping or habitual co-occurrence of words that regularly appear together.
• Amharic: ቃላቶች አብረው የመሄድ/የመጣምመር ልማድ
• Synonyms: Word pairing, Word association, Phrasing
• Antonyms: Random word sequence
• Example: Terms like 'fast food' and 'population growth' are common examples of collocation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Population Pyramid (Noun Phrase)
• English: A graphical illustration showing the distribution of various age groups and sex ratios in a population.
• Amharic: የሕዝብ ዕድሜና ጾታ አወቃቀር ግራፍ (ፒራሚድ)
• Synonyms: Age-sex pyramid, Demographic profile
• Antonyms: Non-structured graph
• Example: A beehive-shaped population pyramid represents a country with low birth and death rates.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Habitation (Noun)
• English: The state or act of living or dwelling in a place.
• Amharic: መኖርያ / የመኖሪያ ቦታ
• Synonyms: Occupancy, Residence, Settlement
• Antonyms: Evacuation, Abandonment
• Example: Over half of the Earth's land mass is suitable for human habitation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Tapered (Adjective)
• English: Becoming progressively narrower or thinner toward one end.
• Amharic: ወደ ጫፍ እየጠበበ የሚሄድ
• Synonyms: Narrowed, Slender, Pointed
• Antonyms: Broadened, Widened, Expanded
• Example: The fourth type of population pyramid has a tapered base that widens near the top.
